text: Update from the Chair, Customer Service Enhancements Working Group.

The Toronto Film, Television, and Digital Media Board recommends to the Economic Development Committee that: 1. The General Manager, Economic Development and Culture invite the Chair, Public Works and Infrastructure Committee and staff from Solid Waste Management to attend a Customer Service Enhancements Working Group meeting to discuss opportunities to assist in production waste reduction and opportunities to reduce on-set emissions prior to July 19, 2018. 2. The General Manager, Economic Development and Culture invite the Chief Planner and Executive Director, City Planning and other appropriate staff working on the TO Core project to attend the Customer Service Enhancements Working Group meeting to discuss criteria for development that includes film friendly features (covered troughs to allow cable to cross the street, covered areas to facilitate Hair/Make-up/Wardrobe and camera,…
